image_description: A wide-angle interior shot of a church sanctuary looking down the central aisle. The focal point is a raised altar at the far end, positioned beneath a large arched stained-glass window. The altar appears to be a stone or marble structure with a frontal decorative panel (possibly blue mosaic or tile) and is flanked by large floral arrangements. Wooden pews line both sides of the aisle in the foreground.

The arch of the window appears slightly asymmetrical, though this could also be due to camera lens distortion.
